newsitem.title: UK: SOCCER-HINCHLIFFE INJURY RULES HIM OUT FOR REST OF SEASON.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-HINCHLIFFE INJURY RULES HIM OUT FOR REST OF SEASON.

text.p: New England defender Andy Hinchcliffe has been ruled out for the rest of the season with knee ligament damage.

The 27-year-old Hinchliffe was a surprise call-up by new England boss Glenn Hoddle for his first World Cup qualifying squad, making his debut in the 2-0 win against Moldova in Kishinev and keeping his place for the subsequent wins over Poland and Georgia.
It seemed likely that the Everton defender would stay in the left-sided wing-back role for February's crunch qualifier against Italy at Wembley.
But he damaged his knee when he crashed into advertising boards during Everton's goalless draw with Leeds on Saturday and Everton boss Joe Royle said on Thursday that Hinchcliffe would need surgery.
